about.intro: KabuK Exchange is Global Travel Distribution Infrastructure created by KabuK Style. We connect supply, connectivity, and distribution through trusted infrastructure designed to reduce operational complexity and strengthen long-term partnerships.
about.mission.copy: Travel has evolved through decades of innovation, but every new relationship can still introduce additional integration, mapping, support, and financial work. KBKx applies proven practices from modern enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, fintech, and platform engineering to the specific realities of travel distribution.
about.shared.title: Built for shared success
about.shared.copy: KBKx is a true B2B2B infrastructure business. We consider the hotels and suppliers contributing inventory, the partners bringing that inventory to market, the technology companies connecting them, and the travelers who ultimately depend on the entire chain working reliably.
about.scale.title: A modern approach that respects the existing ecosystem
about.scale.subtitle: We do not aim to replace the companies that make travel work. We build infrastructure that helps them collaborate with greater trust, clarity, and operational confidence.
about.scale1.d: Reduce repeated point-to-point work while preserving the systems and relationships partners already depend on.
about.scale2.d: Design commercial and operational workflows with the success of both supply and distribution in mind.
about.scale3.d: Use a focused, modern operating model to respond to partner feedback and changing market needs.
about.value1.d: Earn confidence through fair relationships, clear ownership, and responsible handling of critical business operations.
about.value2.d: Make sources, decisions, statuses, changes, and financial activity understandable to the appropriate partners.
about.value3.d: Design predictable technology and operating processes that partners can build their businesses around.
about.value4.d: Treat shared success as the measure of a sustainable B2B2B network.
about.value5.d: Reduce unnecessary complexity instead of shifting it from one participant to another.
about.value6.d: Learn across industries, listen to partners, and improve the infrastructure as the ecosystem evolves.
about.roadmap.title: Clear about what is available and what is planned
about.roadmap.copy: KBKx is evolving toward a broader operating and intelligence layer for travel distribution. Roadmap capabilities—including additional property-system connectivity and KAOS-assisted workflows—are identified as planned until validated and released.

hp2.strategy.title: Local Depth in Asia. Global Breadth Through Connectivity.
hp2.strategy.intro: Our approach combines a focus on direct accommodation relationships across Asia with connections to broader global inventory. That combination is designed to give distribution partners more ways to source accommodation through a single network.
hp2.strategy.c1.d: We prioritize direct relationships with hotels, ryokan, hotel groups and other accommodation providers across Asia.
hp2.strategy.c2.d: Third-party wholesalers, bedbanks and other integrated suppliers can extend accommodation coverage beyond our direct network.
hp2.strategy.c3.d: KabuK Exchange is designed to coordinate content, availability, pricing, booking and settlement workflows across participating supply and demand partners.
hp2.strategy.note: Asia-first describes our supply development priority, not a limit on where partners distribute. Connected global inventory is sourced through integrated third-party suppliers, not direct contracts.
hp2.why.title: Built for the Complexity of Travel Distribution.
hp2.why.intro: Travel distribution involves more than moving rates and availability between systems. KabuK Exchange is being designed to connect multiple sources of accommodation supply with diverse distribution channels while coordinating the commercial and operational workflows that sit between them.
hp2.why.p1.d: We prioritize developing direct accommodation relationships across Asia, where local depth matters.
hp2.why.p2.d: Connected third-party suppliers complement direct supply, giving partners more ways to source accommodation.
hp2.why.p3.d: Content, mapping, availability, pricing, booking and settlement are coordinated through one network relationship.
hp2.why.p4.d: The network is designed to extend over time to new access models and travel products beyond accommodation.
fut.title: Building Beyond Accommodation.
fut.intro: Accommodation is our starting point. As the KabuK Exchange ecosystem develops, we envision additional travel products and new ways for partners to access and distribute inventory.
fut.wl.d: We envision configurable, partner-branded travel experiences that help businesses bring accommodation and other travel products to customers under their own identity.
fut.ap.d: A planned browser-based way for travel agencies to search accommodation inventory, review rates and availability, and manage reservations without building an API integration.
fut.ae.d: We aim to broaden the network over time to support tours, attractions and destination experiences alongside accommodation.
fut.gt.d: We are evaluating opportunities involving airport transfers, private transport, rail and other non-flight ground transportation services.
fut.gt.noflights: Flights are not part of this proposed scope.
fut.disclaimer: Future capabilities are subject to development priorities, technical feasibility, and commercial availability. Statuses do not represent guaranteed launch commitments.

wn.title: Accommodation First. More Travel Products Over Time.
wn.intro: Our initial focus is accommodation distribution, with an Asia-first direct supply strategy and connections to broader global inventory. Future opportunities may include activities and experiences, as well as selected ground transportation categories excluding flights.
wn.wl.note: Storefronts powered by Exchange supply would be an Exchange offering; any reusable white-label technology underneath would belong to KabuK Platform.
wn.cta.title: Interested in What Comes Next?
wn.cta.body: Tell us which future capability matters to your business. Some capabilities described here are planned or under exploration and may not yet be available.
net.nav.d: Direct supply and connected coverage at a glance.
cx.nav.d: Search supported systems and supply connections.
pe.nav.d: Organizations that have approved public recognition.
fm.topic.label: Inquiry topic
fm.system.label: Which channel manager, system or supplier should we connect?
fh.title: Building Stronger Connections with Properties Across Asia.
fh.body: We are developing relationships with hotels, ryokan, and accommodation groups across Asia to support more connected distribution opportunities. Featured properties and groups are shown with their permission.
fc.title: Connected to the Systems Travel Businesses Use.
fc.body: Our connectivity approach combines direct integrations and technology-partner connections to help participating accommodation providers connect with the KabuK Exchange network.
cx.method.explainer: A connection method describes the technical route to a provider. It does not by itself indicate that the integration is live or available to all KabuK Exchange partners.
cx.title: Find Your Connection to KabuK Exchange.
cx.intro: Explore supported channel managers, accommodation systems, and supply integrations. Availability and connection methods vary by provider; each listing indicates how the connection is enabled and its current KabuK Exchange status.
cx.search.label: Search
cx.search.ph: Search channel managers, suppliers, or systems
cx.sort.label: Sort
cx.group.progress: In progress, planned and other statuses
cx.empty: No connections match those filters. Try a different search or reset your filters.
cx.noscript: The connectivity directory needs JavaScript. Contact our team to confirm a specific connection.
cx.verified: Connection details last verified {date}. Availability may vary by partner and market. Contact our team to confirm eligibility.
cx.tp.title: Connected Through Technology Partners
cx.tp.copy: Alongside direct integrations, KabuK Exchange can work with established connectivity partners to connect participating accommodation systems. Individual availability depends on technical validation and commercial enablement.
cx.key.direct: KabuK Exchange connects to the provider’s system without an intermediary.
cx.key.partner: The connection is routed through an established connectivity partner.
cx.cta.title: Don’t See Your System?
cx.cta.copy: Tell us which channel manager, accommodation system, or supplier connection would help your business. Your request helps us evaluate future integration priorities.
net.title: Asia-Focused Supply. Connected Global Coverage.
net.intro: KabuK Exchange is developing direct accommodation relationships across Asia while connecting to broader global inventory through integrated supply partners. Explore the distinction between our direct property network and accommodation available through connected sources.
net.metrics.title: Our Network at a Glance
net.m.directProperties.d: Properties with an active direct commercial agreement with KabuK Exchange.
net.m.directCountries.d: Markets with at least one directly contracted property.
net.m.availableProperties.d: Unique, currently bookable properties across direct and connected supply, counted once across sources.
net.m.countriesCovered.d: Markets with currently bookable inventory from any enabled supply source.
net.metrics.note: Figures reflect verified, deduplicated available inventory as of {date}. Direct and connected supply are counted separately where indicated.
net.model.directFine: A direct commercial agreement does not always mean a direct technical connection — some directly contracted properties connect through a channel manager or technology partner.
net.model.connectedFine: Properties reached through a wholesaler, bedbank or connectivity partner are not counted as directly contracted.
net.map.title: Regional Focus. Global Connections.
net.map.copy: See where KabuK Exchange is developing direct accommodation supply and where connected suppliers extend available inventory. Coverage does not necessarily indicate a direct commercial relationship with properties in that market.
net.map.summary: Direct supply in {direct} markets; connected inventory in {connected} further markets.
net.cta.body: Talk to our team about supply, distribution or connectivity with KabuK Exchange.
pe.title: Connections That Bring Travel Together.
pe.intro: Our ecosystem brings together accommodation suppliers, distribution businesses, and technology providers. Explore organizations that have approved public recognition of their relationship with KabuK Exchange.
pe.search.label: Search partners
pe.filter.label: Filter partners by category
pe.empty: Partner profiles will appear here as public listings are approved.
pe.note: Listings appear with each organization’s permission. A listing does not by itself indicate a live technical integration, a directly contracted property or a commercial endorsement.
hp.eco.none: No entries in this category yet.
hp.eco.t1.d: Properties across Asia exploring direct distribution relationships.
hp.eco.t2.d: Multi-property groups managing distribution across brands and markets.
hp.eco.t3.d: Third-party suppliers that can extend inventory beyond direct supply.
hp.eco.t4.d: Online travel sellers. Some also provide inventory as supplier OTAs.
hp.eco.t5.d: Leisure, corporate and destination specialists sourcing accommodation.
hp.eco.t6.d: Consumer apps, loyalty and subscription programs offering stays.
hp.eco.t7.d: Systems that connect properties’ rates and availability to the network.
